scope: General encounters only; no F2, boss battle, boss rewards, next-map drops or pendingReward.

state.reset: 0 on victory/escape/blocked unsupported species; no encounter on resume
state.autoWalker: Eligible successful steps charge; stop at encounter; never resume automatically
state.persistence: Encounter context, gauge, session runtime remain memory-only. Existing survey persistence unchanged.

ecology.source: generateV2EcologyCandidate2; once per session; currentFloor selects weights
ecology.roll: integer uniform 0..9999 using play RNG; exact weights; no generator stream consumed
ecology.exclusiveSpecies: F1 option B: silberkaefer and maikaefer_koenig have no existing combat definition. Preserve selection, display message and console warning, skip battle without replacement.
ecology.specialThemes: All four supported through the ecology API. Prior explicit-theme blueprint API remains separate from registered/share-code originals; this phase does not invent a persisted theme selector.

flow.entry: Existing ENCOUNTER overlay shape, battleStart SE, 1400ms, shared startBattle/UI, normalBattle BGM
flow.priority: move complete -> torch/survey -> cell prompt -> eligible encounter
flow.resume: Retain the same session/floors in memory, never reconstruct from normal dungeon state. Reset only V2 gauge/lock and stop auto-walker.
flow.defeat: Shared defeat presentation, resolveDungeonDefeat and temple revival; V2 survey flush required before ending session. Failed flush retains session and locks exploration; A retries. Does not run ordinary depth/presence/quest reset.
flow.rewards: Existing enemy stats and EXP/card bonus calculation. Battle EXP and direct ordinary item/gold/equipment/card drops are settled separately, preserving ordinary carried EXP/lootBag. No map-Lv scaling.
flow.redChestLimitation: Ordinary redChest event rewards are not connected in F1 (depth-dependent event/trap flow); explicit result message, no fallback reroll. Direct drops remain enabled.
flow.normalIsolation: No ordinary currentDepth/highestDepth/cells/explored/torch/presence/boss/story/quest mutation. V1 remains without encounters.

browser.route: Development grant -> appraisal/registration with reload -> three maps entered; first map B1/B2/B3, natural encounters and victories.
browser.setup: Isolated test browser saves and test-only hooks, not a user save. Completion commands automated. Escape RNG constrained; defeat uses ordinary RNG with test player HP 1.
browser.outcomes: Escape and defeat/save-failure/retry/temple revival on PC and 390px; see outcomes.json

simulation.profiles: seed12345 / WHITE / Lv5,60,100 / each of 3 floors / lit eligible cells only

surveyHud.placement: Right-aligned immediately below current minimap bounds, including expanded map
surveyHud.expandedMap: V2 expanded map raised 32 canvas pixels to reserve two-line readout on 390px
surveyHud.verification: PC1280 and mobile390 normal/expanded maximum-count bounds assertions; screenshots survey-*.png
